summary: Create an HTTP plug-in registry in the RHDH OpenShift project with `oc new-build httpd --name=plugin-registry --binary`, `oc start-build plugin-registry --from-dir=$DYNAMIC_PLUGIN_ROOT_DIR --wait` and `oc new-app --image-stream=plugin-registry`, then check the .tgz files in its container.
questions: How do I create a plugin registry for RHDH on OpenShift?
How do I verify the plugin-registry has the Ansible plug-ins?

answer_card.title: Create the HTTP plug-in registry
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc project <YOUR_DEVELOPER_HUB_PROJECT>
oc new-build httpd --name=plugin-registry --binary
oc start-build plugin-registry --from-dir=$DYNAMIC_PLUGIN_ROOT_DIR --wait
oc new-app --image-stream=plugin-registry
```
Verify in Topology: open the plugin-registry pod terminal and `ls` for the `ansible-plugin-*.tgz` files.
